CHAPTER 2 · ITEM 01 / 12

Economic thinking and models

Models & evidence模型與證據

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Explain the role of assumptions, simplified models, observations and evidence in economic analysis.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

模型透過假設省略細節，突出重要關係。假設應配合問題及時間範圍，理論須接受資料檢驗。

Models deliberately omit detail to isolate important relationships. Assumptions should fit the question and time horizon. Observations generate hypotheses, and evidence can support or challenge them.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A two-good economy isolates a production trade-off. Adding many goods may obscure this lesson without changing it. 兩商品模型令取捨更清楚。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Why use a simplified model? 為何簡化模型？
